in_sanskrit.name: Gohil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Cowherd, protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gohil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Sanskrit 'go-hila', meaning 'go-hila' - the one who protects the cows. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as a cowherd. The name is thus associated with strength, nurturing, and protection.
